command:
set +e
set -uo pipefail
export PATH=/opt/conda/bin:$PATH TMPDIR=/tmp HOME=/tmp
cd /tmp
# spawn runs task commands under bash -e; `set -uo pipefail` does not clear it (spawn#707).
echo "== staged bytes must match their pins =="
sha256sum -c pins.sha256 || { echo "FAIL: a staged check does not match its pin"; exit 1; }
mkdir -p wh && mv ./*.whl wh/ && (cd wh && sha256sum -c ../wheels.sha256) \
  || { echo "FAIL: a staged wheel does not match its pin"; exit 1; }

echo "== spaCy's test requirements from the staged wheels, offline (the env ships the tests, not these) =="
python3 -m pip install -q --no-index --find-links wh --no-deps wh/*.whl 2>&1 | grep -v "not on PATH" | tail -2
python3 -c "import pytest, hypothesis, mock, pytest_timeout, ml_datasets; print('pytest', pytest.__version__, ' hypothesis', hypothesis.__version__)" \
  || { echo "FAIL: the test requirements did not install from the staged wheels"; exit 1; }
python3 -m spacy info > show.txt 2>&1; cat show.txt

echo "== spaCy's own suite, its CI invocation (.github/workflows/tests.yml, release-v3.8.16) =="
export PYTHONPATH=/tmp
P="--pyargs spacy -p no:cacheprovider -p account"
# Count collection in a SEPARATE process, so "every test is accounted for" is a check between
# two counts rather than one log agreeing with itself.
ACCOUNT_OUT=collect.json python3 -m pytest $P --collect-only -q > collect.log 2>&1
T0=$(date +%s)
ACCOUNT_OUT=run.json python3 -u -m pytest $P -W error -W 'ignore:Core Pydantic V1:UserWarning:pydantic' -q -rsxX --durations=10 > suite.log 2>&1
echo "$? $(( $(date +%s) - T0 ))s" > rc; echo "suite exit/wall $(cat rc)"
python3 -u suite_check.py 4800 4,855 2>&1 | tee suite-summary.txt
test "${PIPESTATUS[0]}" = "0" || { echo "FAIL: spaCy's own suite did not pass cleanly"; grep -E "^(FAILED|ERROR) " suite.log; exit 1; }

echo "== exact claims on tokenization, spans, hashing, serialization, batching, matching =="
python3 -u identities.py 2>&1 | tee identities.log
test "${PIPESTATUS[0]}" = "0" || { echo "FAIL: an identity failed"; exit 1; }
grep -q 'SPACY IDENTITIES OK' identities.log || { echo "FAIL: no completion sentinel"; exit 1; }
uname -m | awk '{print "arch\t"$1}'
echo "DONE"
